verdict.rationale: Automation rules are a fair axis for a commerce and payments platform, but the evidence never documents a user-definable rules or automation engine that fires actions on events. The pack shows only event webhooks (checkout.session.completed, catalog import results, SPT state transitions) and SPT usage limits. Webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing such automation, and usage limits are an adjacent spending control, so neither earns credit for this story.
